b01.text: Doing your 88 days and worried about the new visa ballot?

b03.text: One. It's announced, not in force.

b04.text: Reports say it should start by the end of 2026,

b05.text: but Home Affairs hasn't listed it

b06.text: on its Working Holiday news page yet.

b07.text: Two. Specified work is still required today.

b10.text: Three. UK passport holders already have different rules,

b11.text: so check what applies to your passport.

b12.text: Send this to a mate doing their 88 days.
